description:
## Description

This is an update for the last PR regarding the look at functionality for VRM models. User can now switch between 3 types of eye tracking modes: looking at mouse, looking at camera, and looking forward

## Linked Issues

[https://github.com/moeru-ai/airi/issues/318](https://github.com/moeru-ai/airi/issues/318)

## Additional context

None.

comments.body:
![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

There is a typo in the local storage key for `eyeHeight`. It's using `setting/vrm/eyeHeight` while other keys use the plural form `settings/vrm/...`. For consistency, this should be changed to `settings/vrm/eyeHeight`.

```suggestion
  const eyeHeight = useLocalStorage('settings/vrm/eyeHeight', 0)
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The three buttons for selecting the tracking mode are mostly identical, leading to code duplication. This can be refactored using a `v-for` loop to improve maintainability and readability. This would also make it easier to add or remove tracking modes in the future.

For example, you could define an array of tracking modes in your `<script setup>`:
```javascript
const trackingOptions = [
  { value: 'camera', label: 'Camera', class: 'col-start-3' },
  { value: 'mouse', label: 'Mouse', class: 'col-start-4' },
  { value: 'none', label: 'Disabled', class: 'col-start-5' },
];
```

And in your template:
```html
<template v-for="option in trackingOptions" :key="option.value">
  <Button
    :class="[option.class, 'row-start-6 w-auto']"
    size="sm"
    :variant="trackingMode === option.value ? 'primary' : 'secondary'"
    :label="option.label"
    @click="trackingMode = option.value"
  />
</template>
```
Additionally, the comments are in Chinese, while the rest of the codebase seems to use English. It's good practice to maintain a consistent language for comments.

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

This comment is in Chinese. For consistency with the rest of the codebase, which appears to be in English, please translate it to English.

```
      // Get world coordinates
```

```suggestion
const trackingOptions = computed(() => [
  { value: 'camera', label: t('settings.vrm.scale-and-position.eye-tracking-mode.options.option.camera'), class: 'col-start-3' },
  { value: 'mouse', label: t('settings.vrm.scale-and-position.eye-tracking-mode.options.option.mouse'), class: 'col-start-4' },
  { value: 'none', label: t('settings.vrm.scale-and-position.eye-tracking-mode.options.option.disabled'), class: 'col-start-5' },
])
```

```suggestion
    eye-tracking-mode:
      title: 模型注视方向
      options:
        option:
          camera: 相机
          mouse: 鼠标
          disabled: 禁用
```

```suggestion
    eye-tracking-mode:
      title: Looking at
      options:
        option:
          camera: Camera
          mouse: Mouse
          disabled: Disabled
```
Thank you very much for your help! I've committed all your suggested changes.
